title: Rectangular bar
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. For the first two-dimensional sketch, draw the first face by creating a closed loop with four lines. Begin with the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0477, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.0477, 0.0) to (0.0477, 0.75). Continue with the third line from (0.0477, 0.75) to (0.0, 0.75), and finish with the fourth line from (0.0, 0.75) back to the origin. Apply a sketch scale of 0.75 to this two-dimensional sketch. Transform the sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using Euler angles of 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 and translating it using a vector of 0.0, 0.0, 0.0. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.0477 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction of the normal. The final dimensions of the rectangular bar will be a length of 0.04772727272727272 units, a width of 0.7499999999999999 units, and a height of 0.04772727272727272 units.

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0477) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0477) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0477)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90.0, 0.0, -90.0) and the translation vector is (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

import cadquery as cq

# Long square bar (0.0477 x 0.0477 cross-section, 0.75 long along Y)
# with one long edge chamfered at 45 degrees.
w = 0.0477
c = 0.016          # chamfer leg
L = 0.75           # length along Y

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(w, 0)
    .lineTo(w, w - c)
    .lineTo(w - c, w)
    .lineTo(0, w)
    .close()
    .extrude(L)
)
